tools.name: Placements__apply_arrangement
tools.description:
`applyArrangement`: plan `a` carried out, as ordinary placements, in
a safe order (arranger.hl, "carrying a plan out"); refused with the
fresh plan when it is no longer the plan the fleet would get.

rpc Placements::apply_arrangement of Voice: returns ArrangementApplied; its failure is the handler error CtlError. Requires admin under the exposure's role source; the server still authorizes every request.

inputSchema.description:
`ArrangementApply`: a plan to carry out, the wants it was made for, the
account the seats it adds spend, and the project whose aliases it
points.

ArrangementPin.description:
`ArrangementPin`: a model on `count` nodes, the ones named or any; two
are a pair cabled to each other, the model split across them.

ArrangementRoleWant.description:
`ArrangementRoleWant`: a role to fill, `count` times; `priority` 1 is
filled first, and a role with none after those with one.

PlanAdd.description:
`PlanAdd`: a model placed, in the form placing it would choose: the id
it would be placed as, its variant and runtime, what it would reserve
and hold of each of its nodes' memory for models, what its nodes fetch.
`in_catalog` false when no catalog model names the recipe yet: `model`
is then the recipe's id, the model it would be added as.

PlanAlias.description: `PlanAlias`: the alias a role points, at the model filling it.

PlanDownload.description: `PlanDownload`: what a node fetches for the plan.

PlanKeep.description: `PlanKeep`: a placement left as it is, and the wants it serves.

PlanUnmet.description:
`PlanUnmet`: a want the plan leaves unfilled, and why; and the least
its strongest candidate would hold of each node it needs, when a model
can fill it at all (`least_held`).

items.description:
A weight format (`RuntimeCreate.formats`, `RecipeVariant.format`).
`exl3`: ExLlamaV3's quantized tensors, in safetensors files, which
TensorFold serves.

anyOf.description:
How a runtime's server spans two nodes (`RuntimeCreate.multi_node`):
`mp`, vLLM's own multi-node executor, with no Ray cluster; `lanes`,
TensorFold's two ranks, the leader serving and the follower its lanes,
which run only across two nodes.

multi_node.description:
How a runtime's server spans two nodes (`RuntimeCreate.multi_node`):
`mp`, vLLM's own multi-node executor, with no Ray cluster; `lanes`,
TensorFold's two ranks, the leader serving and the follower its lanes,
which run only across two nodes.

anyOf.description:
How a runtime's server reads a model's weights, when its image ships a
loader faster than the server's default (`RuntimeCreate.load_format`):
`fastsafetensors`, vLLM's `--load-format fastsafetensors`, which reads the
files straight to the GPU rather than through lazily mapped pages.

load_format.description:
How a runtime's server reads a model's weights, when its image ships a
loader faster than the server's default (`RuntimeCreate.load_format`):
`fastsafetensors`, vLLM's `--load-format fastsafetensors`, which reads the
files straight to the GPU rather than through lazily mapped pages.

inputSchema.description: `RuntimeCreate`. `server` is one the node knows how to start (`SERVERS`).
